covers: rmodels.c's DrawSphere, DrawSphereEx and DrawSphereWires (rings bands, normals), DrawCapsule and DrawCapsuleWires (at least one ring; 5.5's parameter order on helix-ray's side), DrawBillboard, DrawBillboardRec and DrawBillboardPro (flipped), 6.2's: each one's vertices as rlgl batches them (lines, triangles, quads as two triangles; texture coordinates, normals, colors)
notes: The filled spheres are of radius 1: raylib 6.2's rlNormal3f leaves a normal as the matrix makes it (rlScalef by the radius), where helix-ray's rlgl, raylib 5.5's, makes it of length 1 again; rlgl isn't taken from 6.2.
